the welfare state in the post-socialist countries is more developed than that in the welfare states, and it is more developed in countries where the socialist heritage is more developed and globalization less developed.

the determinants of welfare state development are different between Western capitalist countries, on the one hand, and post socialist countries, on the other.

the development of the social welfare state in post socialist countries is not only determined by the level of economic development, but also by the socialist past of the country and the extent of globalization.
